verdict.rationale: Pylon clearly supports one-agent omnichannel routing across chat, email, and in-app (chat widget, Slack, email integrations, omnichannel-support doc), but the evidence pack never explicitly documents WhatsApp or social-media channel integrations, which the story specifically calls out. missing for 10: explicit WhatsApp integration docs, explicit social media (e.g. Twitter/Instagram) channel support, and confirmation these route into the same unified agent workflow as chat/email/Slack.
